name: Fort Jesus, Mombasa
description: Fort Jesus stands on Mombasa Island in Kenya, guarding the entrance to the old harbour. The Portuguese built it between 1593 and 1596 to an Italian architect's plan. Its roughly square walls, with a bulwark at each corner, were laid out to echo the proportions of the human body. Moat and ramparts survive remarkably well, and local Swahili builders supplied much of the masonry skill.
